import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Age distribution (convert Year_Birth to Age)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
current_year = 2014  # Based on customer dates
df['Age'] = current_year - df['Year_Birth']
ax1.hist(df['Age'], bins=20, color=colors[0], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax1.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Customer Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Income distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
income_clean = df['Income'].dropna()
ax2.hist(income_clean, bins=25, color=colors[1], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Income Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Education level
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
education_counts = df['Education'].value_counts()
ax3.bar(range(len(education_counts)), education_counts.values, color=colors[2], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(education_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(education_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=9)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('Education Level Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 4. Total spending by category
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_totals = df[spending_cols].sum()
categories = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
bars = ax4.barh(categories, spending_totals.values, color=colors[3:], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Total Spending by Product Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Marital Status
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
marital_counts = df['Marital_Status'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax5.pie(marital_counts.values, labels=marital_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[:len(marital_counts)],
                                     startangle=90)
for text in texts:
    text.set_fontsize(9)
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')
    autotext.set_fontsize(8)
ax5.set_title('Marital Status Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Purchase channels comparison
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
purchase_means = df[purchase_cols].mean()
channels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store']
ax6.bar(channels, purchase_means.values, color=colors[4:7], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax6.set_ylabel('Average Number of Purchases', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Average Purchases by Channel', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Income vs Total Spending scatter
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
df['TotalSpending'] = df[spending_cols].sum(axis=1)
scatter = ax7.scatter(df['Income'], df['TotalSpending'], alpha=0.6, c=df['Age'], 
                     cmap='viridis', s=50, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.5)
ax7.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Income vs Total Spending (colored by Age)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax7)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=9)
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 8. Campaign acceptance rates
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = df[campaign_cols].mean() * 100
campaigns = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Response']
ax8.bar(campaigns, acceptance_rates.values, color=colors[1], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
ax8.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 9. Number of children at home
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
df['TotalChildren'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
children_counts = df['TotalChildren'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax9.bar(children_counts.index, children_counts.values, color=colors[5], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax9.set_xlabel('Number of Children', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax9.set_title('Total Children at Home Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

plt.suptitle('Customer Marketing Campaign Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
